_doc: Channel audio dials for build_audio.py. Sourced from universal.md §13a-iii.8 (measured audio grammar). Data only — no logic; SFX/pause/music/dry placement is authored by the audio-director. Breath + master_target REFINED 2026-07-10 from the audio-only reference teardown (8 videos; visual-kit/research/audio-logs/synthesis.md).
_sentence_gap_note: R11 2026-07-20 (refines R10 PAD-TO-TARGET, which supersedes the R8-B additive +0.5s law). After every sentence-final word, pad the boundary's REAL MEASURED acoustic silence (low-RMS run in the VO audio itself, threshold sentence_gap_measure_threshold_db default -38 dBFS) UP TO a target and insert only the shortfall; insert nothing when the measured silence already meets it (target 0.65s body, 0.45s chained <=2-word; nothing below 0.02s). R10 used the start-to-start onset proxy, which overstated the gap by the final word's own spoken duration and drifted at TTS chunk seams — suppressed pads = the r10 'rushed second half' defect. Splice cuts inside the measured silence run (valley) + room-tone fill (breath.py). Realized by breath.py sentence_gaps()/splice_silence(); verified post-render by audio_checker.check_sentence_gaps.
_dip_in_pause_note: R7 2026-07-17 (M15, Daniel-directed): the bed CONTINUES at present level through authored pauses - no per-pause dip. Full music cuts remain only on dry spans + track-switch gaps. Set true to restore the old dip-every-pause behavior.
_dip_db_note: The DEEP full-stop dip: whatever music plays drops to near-silence across a breath gap (number-reveal / chapter-boundary), so the beat lands in real silence. This is the ONLY music-drop the lane generates besides dry spans + track-switch gaps — we deliberately do NOT emit the references' frequent shallow on-beat dips (spec 2026-07-12-phase3b §2b).

master_target._note: The LIVE final-master target — build_motion.loudnorm_pass reads these on every render (ffmpeg loudnorm, single-pass). Ear-gated 2026-07-12 on _chain-test (A/B: -14 read too loud, -15.5 slightly too quiet → -14.5). LRA 4 = the measured comedic-channel compression (refs ~-18 LUFS but CLIP; we hold TP headroom). YouTube re-normalizes playback to ~-14 anyway, so this mostly sets peak headroom + compression character. Phase 4 checker will VERIFY the render hit this.

_pause_note: Deliberate PAUSE gaps are AUTHORED `pause` cues in audio-plan.json (build_motion -> breath.py splices them into a derived vo.breath.mp3, SEPARATE from the writer's [PAUSE]/[BEAT] prosody baked in the VO). The dip lands in the gap. Measured breath: a sustained hit earns ~0.55s (range 0.3-0.8), only ~20% of events.
_consistent_sfx_note: Structural motif SFX that use ONE fixed variant (no pool rotation) so they read as a recognizable recurring sound within a video — a scene whoosh + an element pop must sound the same every time (ear-gate 2026-07-12). Content/comedic SFX still rotate for variety.

sfx_pools._note: Sourced via sfx-forge (Freesound CC0, CLAP-ranked, human-gated, peak-normalized to -1 dBFS). Provenance in audio/manifest.json. pop/tick/pluck/stamp deferred (fires_now=false, no card content yet).
sfx_pools._crack_note: R8 2026-07-17 (P22): crack-2 (icy-lake impact, CC0, centroid 2092 Hz) replaces crack-1 (6691 Hz 'twig' read). crack-1/crack-3 stay on disk as alternates.
sfx_pools._r7_pools_note: R7 2026-07-17: applause/boo/halo_vocal/sparkle_long sourced (r7-sourcing run; provenance in audio/manifest.json; -2 alternates stay on disk, re-add to rotate). Single-entry pools so repeated cues (halo_vocal fires 3x) stay identical. halo_vocal REPLACES the harp-gliss halo in this video's cues; halo-1 remains for instrumental use.
sfx_pools._halo_vocal_note: R10 2026-07-18: reverted to halo_vocal-1 (pre-R8, 261 Hz) - Daniel prefers the previous, lower ahh over the R8 halo_vocal-2. halo_vocal-2/-3 stay as alternates. The floating-book sustained bed halo_vocal_book-1 is a composite of halo_vocal-1 x6 (acrossfade d=1.269s), pinned per-cue in audio-plan.json.

_music_present_note: Constant present level under a playing music segment (dB attenuation vs full; 1 unit = 1 dB). R10 2026-07-18 -> 10 (-3 dB vs the original 7 baseline): the R9 full-video ear-gate found 9 still a touch loud; -1 more per Daniel 'not by too much'. Constant by design (no per-phrase duck). music_pools._note: Mood-bucket -> [bed file names] (audio/beds/<name>.mp3), sourced via music-forge (Incompetech CC-BY, loudness-normalized to music_norm_lufs). Buckets (music-forge/music-buckets.json): casual-comedic idiom = casual-bed/upbeat/sneaky; restrained exposE-underscore register (2026-07-17 retrack) = underscore (DEFAULT con-spine bed) + somber (elegiac tail). `underscore` REPLACES the meme-coded `sneaky` cues as the default con-spine; `sneaky` and upbeat-1 (Monkeys Spinning Monkeys) remain for OCCASIONAL deliberate comedic use. EMPTY/absent pool = 'no music for that mood'. Provenance in audio/manifest.json['music'].
music_pools._upbeat4_note: R8 2026-07-17 (P07): upbeat-4 = Cheery Monday (CC-BY) replaces upbeat-3 Ascending the Vale in the middle span - demucs measured vocals in upbeat-3 (Daniel's ear confirmed); upbeat-4 = top CLAP among the vocal-free non-meme candidates. upbeat-3 file stays on disk, OUT of the pool + credits. All upbeat spans pin per-cue.
music_pools._underscore_curation_note: R6 2026-07-17: underscore curated to ONE track (underscore-1 Crypto, top CLAP) so the con-spine bed never re-picks mid-video (audit: mid-video track swaps read inconsistent). underscore-2/3/4 stay in audio/beds/ as ear-gate alternates - re-add here to rotate. upbeat reordered so index 0 = upbeat-2 (Fig Leaf, non-meme lift); upbeat-1 (Monkeys) = deliberate use only.

_music_fade_note: R10 2026-07-18 (W12, Daniel-ruled): music fades are LONG by default - every bed enters on a ~1.2s swell and leaves on a ~2.5s fade that starts earlier; track_switch_gap_s 1.2 between different beds. Per-cue fade_out_s in audio-plan.json may author LONGER still; these defaults are the floor. Doctrine: audio-director SKILL.md Placement laws.
